sections.label: Not just another return
sections.html:
Warranty claims run through the same portal as returns and exchanges, but three things work differently.

AspectReturnWarranty claim
OutcomeRefund, gift card, or exchangeA replacement
Proof of purchaseThe retailer’s own orderAny order, including Amazon, Walmart, or Best Buy: the shopper enters the order number or uploads a receipt, and staff verify it
Time limitThe return windowThe warranty period

sections.label: After a claim
sections.html:
Each retailer sets a separate workflow for each case.

  • In stock: Exact replacementChecked against the store’s live inventory.
  • Out of stock: A choiceA replacement from the full catalog, or a way to contact the retailer.

sections.label: Who used it
sections.html: Mostly enterprise customers selling consumer products, who until then had handled warranty claims outside ReturnLogic.
